dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Ten crates of meat, ten crates of vegetables, various amounts of firewood and camping equipment to be given to the Millelith outpost... Three crates of various ores to be sent to the Huishan Hall warehouse in exchange for spare parts for tools... in various amounts...

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Alright, sorry for making you wait. What do you need... Ah, it's you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Since when were we all that familiar with you...?

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: I mean, you are the heroes who saved Liyue. Your deeds are remembered by us all.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Since you're here at The Chasm, you must be here on some important business. In which case, I'm sure you must have a permit from Lady Keqing, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We don't.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Really? I mean, sorry to trouble you... Since you must be very familiar with Lady Ningguang, a permit from her might hold still more weight. Could I see it, please?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, we don't have that, either.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Well, the Lord Tianshu is reclusive yet approachable, and also has great vision and the good of the people at heart. Surely he was the one who gave you permission to enter the Chasm, then?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: May... maybe?

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: In that case, would you mind letting me see your papers?

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Huh, I guess you don't have that, either. Well, Ms. Ganyu works at Yujing Terrace, supporting the Qixing directly, so I'm sure her opinion would be in lockstep with theirs. You at least have her permission, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Actually, you know what? We could have just asked Ganyu to sign off on this!)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can, uh, go look for her right now...

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: *sigh* ...

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: So... you've come at a bad time. This is really not the season to be visiting The Chasm. The Ministry of Civil Affairs is still working on eliminating a great safety hazard within, so this is still very much a danger zone.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: If you have been commissioned by some merchant to urge us to open the mine faster, then I suggest you read the report I submitted to Shenglu Hall carefully.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, what's this person talking about, exactly?
